title: Inertia of Art: Create Poem for the #clmooc #poetryport
summary: That which exists in our mist will resist change matter does not rearrange inertia, takes force of course to push pebble or stone, lazy matter prefers to be left alone Yet the mind can can create a synergy of energy always in motion A tryst of emotion, or passing of time insist it must exist So an alchemist of the soul wisking nature's mixing bowl of meaning
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
That which exists
in our mist
will resist
change
matter does
not rearrange
inertia, takes
force of course
to push pebble or stone, lazy
matter prefers to be left alone

Yet the mind can can create
a synergy of energy
always in motion
A tryst of emotion, or
passing of time insist
it must exist
So
an alchemist of
the soul wisking
nature's mixing bowl
of meaning
rearranges and exchanges
that which did not
consist
only to see art persist
as the lazy matter
that truly matters
